steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Hold on for ten more minutes. Blacksteel's convoy will be here soon.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: That's not going to take us to the energy tower.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: I'll stay behind... Y'all go on ahead.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: How much time can you buy us?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: How much time do you need?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: At least... half an hour?
Woodrow draws his revolver from its holster and counts the bullets.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: ...An hour, maybe? You need time to set the explosives, too.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: More than enough.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Woodrow...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Goodbye, Woodrow.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Hurry. Right, Jessica...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What is it, sir?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Thanks... Thanks for bringing it all the way here.
Woodrow fixes his hat and turns around to walk down the long street. Soon, his silhouette has disappeared into the night, leaving only a farewell ringing in the air.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Until we meet again, friends.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Sir, we've finished testing the propulsion equipment. The Engineering team is double checking the connection's structural integrity now.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Sir?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: What's the ETA for our departure?

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Everything should be ready by Wednesday.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Good... Very good.

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: P-Pardon me, but I have something to report.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: I'll take my leave, then.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: The team stationed on the plate has requested backup. They say a gang of robbers have blown open the bank's vault door and stolen all the reserve funds inside.

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: There are four of them... and they've all been identified. It's Mr. Bianchi and his friends, as well as...

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: As well as who?

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: As well as Miss Brynley.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: ...Huh.

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: Should we send anyone, considering that you just sent away all the security personnel stationed at the bank the other day...?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Let's prioritize preparing to tow the plate. No need to stop the work we have on hand. But... send out anyone we have to spare.

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: One more thing. Considering Miss Brynley's unique status, should we...?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Don't hurt her. We have to save face for the Brynleys, after all. As for Woody... I don't see us subduing him uninjured.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Forget it... Just make sure he stays alive. As for the rest, let the troops do as they see fit.

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: Alright, understood.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Right, which one's carrying the cash?

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: Still unclear.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: No matter who it is, send Tila and have her keep a close eye.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: H-Have you heard the news? Jessica...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: We have to do something. The order from above is that, aside from Jessica and Woodrow, the teams can deal with everyone else as they see fit. That's all it says.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...Franka.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Tell everyone to prepare to deploy. We got the order to hunt them down, too.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And you're going to follow it?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...We can help them, or we could take them in. But either way it's a race against time.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We need to find them before anyone else does.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Helena, Leone, this is as far as I can take you.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm hearing sounds of transports that aren't from main street. Blacksteel probably sent additional men after us, just as we anticipated.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Are we going through with the plan?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Yeah, I'll stay outside to lure them away.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Godspeed... Leave this last leg of the journey to us.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Phew... Okay, Jessica...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Now you can only trust yourself.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Looks like Blacksteel will be dragging the plate off to the city in the next couple days. They have only a few guys guarding the door. Bet they have everyone else working on the connection.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Perfect... Won't be too hard to deal with, then.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: How are those soldiers doing...?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Sleeping like babies. Might wake up with a sore neck though.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: We need to hurry. If we want to blow up the power plant and seal off that passage completely, we need to set up the explosives there.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Look at those car lights... the Blacksteel people must be getting close to the mine.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Helena... you should go. I can take care of this by myself.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Leone...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Your job is more important.

steps.name: Twitchy Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: We still haven't broken through their defenses?

steps.name: Helpless Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Not a single car can get close to the central avenue.

steps.name: Twitchy Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: How many robbers are there out on the street?

steps.name: Helpless Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Just one... a Sankta.

steps.name: Twitchy Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Is the backup here yet?

steps.name: Helpless Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Twitchy Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Let's stop the car here... Have everyone still with us bring their gear. We'll go around the road and break through from there.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Ambush up ahead...

steps.name: Rational Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Going by the bullet marks... That's Blacksteel etched ammo. Good news, we found our princess.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: ...Give me the amplifier.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Ahem... Miss Brynley. Whatever your reasons are for participating in this robbery, we won't make this hard on you as long as you cooperate and turn yourself in.

steps.name: Rational Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: (Whispers) Draw her attention. I'll send out a drone to track her.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Stay back. I'm not surrendering.

steps.name: Rational Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: (Whispers) The bullet came from that diner over there.

steps.name: Rational Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: (Whispers) Let's get in position. We'll attack as soon as we're ready.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Miss Brynley, you may not understand what's going to happen to you after this. You will be sent to prison, be abandoned by your friends and family, and society will look at you with disdain... Can you really bear all that?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sir... With all due respect, I've worked with everyone at Blacksteel for a long time now. I'm not the naive rich girl I used to be.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I know better than anyone what the price of this is.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But I still have to do it...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: There are some things you just do, no matter the price.

steps.name: Twitchy Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: That guy up ahead... That him?

steps.name: Helpless Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Sure, he looks like a normal old man, but you see those transports flipped upside down? He did that.
Like a wandering lost soul, the figure stands still in the middle of the road, under the flickering streetlights.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Kid... Is there something you can't say to my face?

steps.name: Helpless Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: He can hear us from this far away?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: I've lived in far noisier places than this. I only survived this long thanks to my sharp ears.

steps.name: Helpless Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: A legendary mercenary like you must have a lot of awe-inspiring stories to tell.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: A legendary mercenary... Now that's the first time anyone's described me like that.

steps.name: Helpless Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: There's a long corridor in Blacksteel where pictures of our founder and his war buddies are hung. I saw one with you and our boss in it. It's inconspicuous, but I noticed it.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: What a shame... My stories ain't as legendary as you think. All I've been through is war.

steps.name: Twitchy Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: That doesn't matter... Actually, I've wanted to fight the boss for quite a well, too. Still, he's the boss. I can't exactly pull a gun on him.

steps.name: Twitchy Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: But if you and him are in the same picture, old man, I wonder what that says about your skills.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Rotten.

steps.name: Helpless Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: You mean so rotten you could throw a dozen of our teams for a loop and single-handedly keep us pinned down on this street?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: I mean so rotten that everyone I ever wanted to save died a miserable death right in front of me. Everything I ever wanted to protect fell before my eyes.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Those I loved chose to leave me. Those I despised, I couldn't kill with my own hands.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: I ain't no legend... I'm just an old failure of a beckbeast.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: An old beckbeast guarding the only bones that he has left.
When he sees the old man's fingertip twitch, the mercenary keenly realizes that something terrible is about to go down.
He aims his weapon at the target as fast as he can, but a bullet pierces his shoulder first.

steps.name: Twitchy Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Ugh—!

steps.name: Helpless Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Dammit, I can't even see what he's doing.

steps.name: Twitchy Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: So how come I'm starting to think this is getting fun?

steps.name: Helpless Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Stop approaching him, you madman!

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Careful. Not a step closer, kid.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: ...I'm putting everything on the line for this.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: So you came in here anyway.

steps.name: Rational Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Miss Brynley, bullets can ricochet indoors. I don't want to hurt you.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I don't want to hurt you, either. Please take everyone with you and leave.

steps.name: Rational Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: I'm sorry, but this is the mission handed down to us. Not everyone's a princess like you, who can do whatever she pleases.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm so sorry about all this...
The girl's voice is coming from behind the booth seats. It is soft and with a hint of doubt. Just like the mercenary's first impression of her—sensitive and cowardly.
He carefully inches forward with his handgun drawn and held up next to his face.

steps.name: Rational Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: This...
There is no one sitting in the booth. Just a sniper rifle on the table. The device on the trigger ensures it can be remotely controlled.
A communication device sits beside it. The girl's voice can be heard through its speakers.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...I really am sorry.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: The target is not in the rear kitchen.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Second floor is clear.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Not outside, either.

steps.name: Rational Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: She's not here...

steps.name: Rational Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Hurry and withdraw immediately. This is a feint—

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: If you know I do whatever I please... why did you expect me to act exactly how you anticipated?

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: No, don't withdraw yet!
A fiery beam of light crashes into the ground outside the window.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: All units! Get down—
Before he can finish, there is a loud explosion.
A tire crashes through the window and, still smoking and on fire, makes a few loops on the ground before falling to the glass-strewn floor.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...All blown up. Without any transports, it'll take some time for them to make it to the power plant.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That's plenty.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Were there more of them?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Looks like I need to hurry.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: According to the plan, you'll leave through this secret passage, and I'll set off the power plant. Once this place explodes, no one will find the passage.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Leone...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Do you have a map of the route?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: This path is connected to the underground sewer system. The passages there are complicated and twisty. Only one will lead you outside the plate.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Jessica hid some transports and supplies near the exit. Avoid military stations on the way to the frontier... There's bound to be plenty of thugs and bandits, too.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Leone, how many times have we been over this already? As for the dangers of the road, Woodrow's talked my ear off about them already. Yes, it's dangerous, we all know that.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I'm just worried...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: I don't like making promises, you know.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: But I can promise you this: No matter what happens, I'll do everything to reach my destination. Even if I fall—

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: You won't.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: You won't, Helena. Because I'll be right behind you. I'll take down every obstacle that slows you down.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: That's my promise to you.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: You just need to keep running straight ahead. Remember, keep going straight. Don't look back.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: I will, Leone... Goodbye...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Now go. Hurry.
He looks on as the dark, narrow tunnel engulfs Helena's silhouette. Finally, he can't help but turn around to take a look at the plant's generator in the center of the room.
There is barely anyone left on the plate, but the fire in the furnace burns as strong as ever.
The flames are reflected in his eyes. Dancing, stirring, leaping.
Yet even that is unable to melt the frigid ice lying in their depths.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Now... It's just you and me.

steps.name: Helpless Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: You're late. The old Sankta's gone.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Where did he go...?

steps.name: Twitchy Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: The mine.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You're wounded...

steps.name: Twitchy Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: It's fine. He held back... Ugh... I almost had him. Dammit.

steps.name: Helpless Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: ...One suggestion. If you girls run into him, try attacking his left shoulder.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I appreciate the advice. Now if you'll excuse us.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Faster... I have to hurry...
Leone sets the explosives on the wall and lifts his hand to wipe all the sweat that's gathered on his brow, but the heat immediately causes his skin to sweat even more.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hurry...
His lips start chapping. His saliva no longer serves to moisten his throat and mouth.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Faster...
He sticks another one onto the wall, then another, and another...
The light of the intense fire sweeps into the bottom of his eyes, seemingly tearing his soul in two. One half supports his body's movements so that he can keep working.
While the other half has left his body entirely and stands firm in front of the furnace, staring into the raging fire.
As he attaches another stick of dynamite to the wall, he notices someone walking toward him from the light of the fire.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Come with me, Leone. We'll head to the frontier. That's where our new home is.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Miles... Don't go. Where are you going?
Another stick of dynamite is set on the wall. Miles turns toward the furnace, and a small shadow emerges.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: I'm planning to leave Davistown. I don't want to stay here anymore. I'm leaving, Dad.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Benny...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Don't leave me... You're the only child I have left... Don't leave me like Carl did!
Another stick of dynamite on the wall. The fire engulfs Benny, and twists into a tall, young man.

steps.name: Carl
steps.text: Good news, Dad. There's a mercenary company that thinks I'm pretty good. They say I'm a good fit for the gig... I'll be leaving in a few days.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: No... Don't go. I won't let you.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: You'll die on the battlefield, Carl!
Another stick of dynamite. The young man turns into a fireball and explodes in all directions.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: No... Carl, come back!
The final stick of dynamite is set up on the wall.
A woman emerges from the fireball. He no longer remembers what she looked like, but he never once forgot her voice.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Mom...

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Leone...

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: I have to go now. I'm sorry... I can't support you anymore...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Mom... Don't apologize. I'm doing well here.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Leone, sorry for leaving you all alone.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: No, Mom. I have a family here... Everyone here is my family.

steps.name: Gentle Female Voice
steps.text: Goodbye, Leone.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Stay here, Mom...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Stay here... with me.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Leone, how are things going on your end?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: The explosives are all in the place... Once they're set off, the plant will explode in no time. Then, after the energy tower comes crashing down, no one will ever find that passage again.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: When are you leaving? I've lured the nearby mercenaries away, so I'm on my way there to pick you up.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: No... Don't come.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Have you already left?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: No, it's just... I don't want to go.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Jessica, tell this to Sylvia for me.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No... I won't. If you have something to tell her, tell her yourself.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: She's... She's a clever girl, and still so young. A nice girl. If she finds a good man in the frontier, she should let herself fall in love again.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I want her to be happy... God... why'd I have to treat her like that? If I'd known Carl was going to...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Carl...?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: No... Forget what I said. Tell her... Tell her I'm glad she still remembers and loves Carl...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: But he's gone... He's not here anymore...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: The living... deserve a choice...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: The living... shouldn't be bogged down by the dead...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You deserve a choice, too. You need to live, and leave this place. You'll get to start fresh in the future.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Don't do anything stupid, I'm begging you! Think about Woodrow and Helena. They'll be heartbroken!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: And Benny! He just started school. He's got a bright future ahead of him. Don't you want to see what kind of man he'll become? Don't you want to see your son again?!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: And Miles... He's still waiting for you...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: But... she wants me to stay...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: ♪She spread her arms, spread her heart, showed me that pretty face♪

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: ♪And from that moment on, I found my dreams in her embrace♪

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Listen to me, Jessica. I can't leave this place. Because... Because that woman left me here on a rainy spring day.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: It was the perfect day for a seedling to take root and sprout. My... My roots have grown too deep. No one can pluck me out anymore.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Leone...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: It's gonna be a big bang. Cover your ears. Don't be afraid, and don't be sad.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: My life didn't begin the day I was born. It began the day I got here.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: In the same way, my death won't be on the day my life comes to an end. It'll be the day I leave this place.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Leone, please...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Don't worry, Jessica. I won't die. Because I'll be here forever...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I'll live forever in her embrace...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No—!
A loud explosion rings out high up above, and its massive shockwave shoves Jessica to the ground.
She tries her hardest to get up and move her legs, to run forward, but she finds herself unable to budge. Her body has never felt so heavy before.
She lifts her head up to look into the distance. A thick cloud of smoke is gushing out of a giant fissure in the tower's body.
The rubble mercilessly pummels the ground alongside a shower of sparks, turning the nearby buildings into wreckage beyond recognition.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No...
A frigid wind blows toward her from afar, turning everything before her into nothing but a hazy blur, and leaving the corners of her eyes feeling awfully cold.
She reaches her fingers up toward the sky, as though she is trying to grasp something in the haze.
She blinks, and her vision starts to clear up. She sees a snowflake.
It's snowing.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Is that... the power plant? Hurry, Franka, drive faster!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You hear that, you stupid car?! Faster!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Did... Did it work?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Jessica... What's the situation there?

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Leone... respond...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: ...I'm not getting a signal.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Dammit.
Helena stops in her tracks, and considers turning back to look.
The underground passage's structure, fragile to begin with, is unable to withstand the explosion on the surface. The fissures on the walls are rapidly spreading as far out as she can see.
Almost as if underlining the fact that she is walking a path of no return.
And so, in the end, she doesn't turn around. Instead, she keeps running.
She simply throws herself into the hidden tunnel, and towards the unknown up ahead.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: ...I really have gotten old.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Couldn't even dodge a little explosion like that...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: That's... toward the energy tower.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Jessica...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Woodrow...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: What's the situation at the energy tower? Has Helena entered the underground passage yet?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Leone... said he was staying... He said he didn't want to leave...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I didn't see him come out...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I waited... Maybe I missed him...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Does Helena know?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I... I can't reach her...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Are you crying?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Am I? I think I am.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: *sigh*... It's all over now. You'll be fine. Let's see... You're from Blacksteel, and a Brynley. They won't touch you.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Where are you going, Woodrow? Can... Can I come look for you?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: I still got some stuff to take care of... Can't go bringing you with me.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Will I ever see you again?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Maybe, Jessica... Maybe.
Woodrow leans on the wall. He feels dazed and dizzy, and the burn wound on his shoulder aches.
He takes out the bullet from his pocket. He can barely make it out under the faint moonlight, so all he does is rub its engraving.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: (In Lateran) Forgiveness... Damned right.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: May this bullet forgive what my heart cannot.
